meta.bbox_east_note: v2 (T-203): east edge widened +248 m for Bandshell Park + the S Duff corridor context; buildings east of core_bbox_east_v1 classify by the census §6 rule (build_buildings)
meta.bbox_south_note: v3 (T-204): south edge widened +1.0 km to 42.0030 (SUMMARY §3's planned window) for Reiman Gardens + the ISU Vet Med campus + the south blocks; buildings south of core_bbox_south_v2 classify by the census §6 rule (build_buildings)
meta.bbox_north_note: v4 (T-205): north edge widened to 42.0780 past the whole Ada Hayden Heritage Park (relation 12032468, bbox lat 42.05999..42.07618 — the ticket's twin-lakes/trail-ring criteria need the park at data geometry and walkable; SUMMARY §3's own +1.6 km north window (42.0500) stops ~2 km short of it), landing the park + Moore Memorial + Inis Grove + The Cafe (2616 Northridge Pkwy) + the north blocks; buildings north of core_bbox_north_v3 classify by the census §6 rule. v4 also joins named water bodies (>= 1 ha) and the north parks' trails (build_water / build_trails).
meta.facing_convention: compass degrees, 0 = north (-Z), 90 = east (+X); Godot yaw = -deg_to_rad(facing_deg)

street_km.method: census §4: segment midpoints inside the core bbox; named drivable classes only. This is the rule the streets[] graph pins (clean per-way polyline runs with class/width semantics).
